shortTitle: Ever-Tite Roofing v. Green — noncontiguous assigned ex…
summary: The form invited written approval or commencement of performance; the assigned conclusion treats loading and transporting materials as commencement.
notes: Printed p. 226 is excluded by the syllabus even though pp. 225 and 227 are included. The available conclusion states that the interval for processing the financing application was reasonable, that performance began before notice of dissent, and that the judgment was reversed. The notes compare White’s different invitation and the distinction between bilateral and unilateral acceptance.
